title: intelli-light SessionState
description: Cross-platform wire format for one Codex or Claude agent session.

state.description: Wire state. Known values are normalized by the state contract; unknown values map to Idle.

startedAt.description: Unix seconds when the current turn began; 0 means no active clock.

pausedTotal.description: Accumulated paused seconds for the current turn.

pauseStart.description: Unix seconds when the current pause began; 0 means not paused.

ts.description: Unix seconds when the writer last updated this state.
